versionPairs.description: A mixed Bun app (Bun 1.3.14, `bun build --target=bun --format=cjs`, unminified): the bun-plain app with two of its six modules (archive, codec) reached only through require() from a CommonJS loader, so Bun wraps those two in lazy inits and the other four stay eager. The markers cover ~45% of the app code, under the 99% threshold: the split takes the fresh grouping for all of it, and each module's report lands in its own file (on main the marker method piled the four eager modules into one src/index.js — finding C2). Generated by ../bun-apps. v1.1.0 changes the palette (eager) and archive (lazy) reports and adds a function to the CommonJS dep.
